This T/T genotype carries two copies of T. In the independent Deelen 2019 extreme-longevity GWAS (survival beyond the 90th age percentile, European ancestry), the mvARD-raising allele T had log-odds -0.0122 (SE 0.0563; P=0.829), i.e. lower odds of extreme longevity, the direction the geroscience hypothesis predicts; not statistically significant on its own. The nearest gene reported by FUMA (SVEP1, as named in the paper) is positional annotation only, not an assigned causal gene. mvARD is a unitless latent factor; this is a population-level association, not an individual disease-risk or lifespan estimate, and it must not be summed with other rows as a polygenic score.
